title: Assistant panel: ask, summarize, key insights, citations
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-06 and A-16 work on a real document, with citations that navigate and a stop control
notes: App half of the assistant panel per ADR 0011, serialised after T-0252 and the citation task T-0254. Serves acceptance items A-06 (command bar AI Assistant activates its working tool) and A-16 (ask, summarize, key insights on the open document through OpenCode) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Implements the three placements in the acceptance image (command-bar pill, panel card, rail entry), streamed answers, page citations that navigate to the cited page, a stop control, a per-document conversation, and a 'Connect to OpenCode' state when no service is connected. Document text is untrusted tool output; nothing is sent before the user asks. Depends on T-0254 (citation extraction); until that task record exists and verifies, this task cannot be claimed. When the assistant ships, update `crates/pdfxi-app/src/shell/help.rs`: the privacy text says 'The optional AI assistant is not enabled in this build', which becomes false. It must state that the assistant connects only when the user asks, to the local OpenCode service, what document text is sent, and how to disconnect. Replace the `RailItem::AiAssistant => self.future_panel(...)` placeholder with the real rail entry/panel. Promote SEC-013 when the assistant panel actually uses `create_locked_session`/`attach_locked_mcp`, sends nothing until the user asks, and works on `opencode-go/hy4-flash-free`; include SEC-013 in the fragment. After the assistant panel ships, update `docs/book/src/privacy.md` and `docs/book/src/security.md` so the 'panel inert / no request path / no Connect control' paragraphs reflect the live Connect/Disconnect and what-is-sent behavior; do not leave the current-build caveat once it is false.
